scope: Remove missing preview files without deleting source/history or weakening reload ownership

requirements.contract: Prune before restore/preparation/navigation/status, including hidden restored galleries; repair count/index while preserving surviving selection.
Memory and file transfer, inline and side layouts: empty galleries hide widget/status/overlay, clear payload caches, stop animation/cycle and free only owned graphics.

Two-second nonoverlapping visible-gallery reconciliation, at most eight async stats, no render-path filesystem access, no idle stream/hidden-gallery polling; close cancels pending work before ctx invalidation.
ENOENT/ENOTDIR/non-file removal does not classify EACCES as deletion; valid symlinks remain; late probes cannot discard a replacement object/path.
Explicit share of a vanished selection returns no image, not a different gallery item. No source/history deletion.

real_boundary: Pi 1.1.0 private PTYs: aboveEditor/belowEditor/rightOverlay, two reloads then delete visible fixture, scoped GPU free before inspection, empty/hidden state, same PID and restored terminal on clean exit.
deployment: No live agent restarted; no operator gallery cleared. Source update takes effect when the extension is reloaded or started fresh.
